create.name: Jeffrey Eisen
create.bio:
Jeffrey Eisen is a spiritual life coach, Reiki Master and channel based in Toronto, Canada. For around thirty years he led a steel company as its president and chief executive, until a spiritual awakening in his early fifties turned him towards inner work. It began with journaling through a hard period, when he noticed the words arriving with a voice and depth he did not recognise as his own. He came to know this presence as Shaltazar, a non-physical collective whose messages he has now been receiving for more than twenty years.

The Shaltazar material runs to a few hundred short channelled teachings on themes such as trust, letting go, self-worth, unity and listening for inner guidance. Jeffrey shares them as written posts, recorded talks, Insight Timer tracks and live sessions, and through a 55-card oracle deck made with Mark Layne and the artist Sara Sanguino. He also works one to one over Zoom, offering ongoing coaching, personal channelled sessions and oracle card readings that pair intuitive insight with practical next steps. Away from this work he is a keen nature and travel photographer.

courses.title: 1-on-1 Spiritual Life Coaching
courses.description: Ongoing one-to-one coaching over Zoom for people facing a transition, an awakening or a pattern they cannot seem to shift. Sessions can include intuitive guidance, gentle energy work and practical tools, and a free 45-minute clarity call comes first.

courses.title: Personalized Shaltazar Channelling
courses.description: A private hour on Zoom in which Jeffrey channels a message from Shaltazar addressed to your own questions, followed by time to reflect on it together. You keep a video recording of the message.

courses.title: Personal Oracle Card Reading
courses.description: A thirty-minute live reading using the Wisdom of Shaltazar deck, where a card is drawn for you and its message explored in conversation. It comes with a recording, a PDF of the card and an audio track of its message.

courses.title: One Card Oracle Reading
courses.description: A short written reading: you send in a question or area of life, and Jeffrey draws a single card from the Shaltazar deck and responds with a personal message. It suits anyone wanting a quick check-in without booking a session.

courses.title: Wisdom of Shaltazar Oracle Card Audio Collection
courses.description: Recordings of all 55 card messages from the Shaltazar oracle deck, read by Claire Ottewell over music by Narek Mirzaei. One message can be heard free on the page before buying the set.

courses.title: A Shaltazar Guide To The Art Of Communicating With The Unseen World
courses.description: A seven-day Insight Timer course, about a quarter of an hour a day, on noticing the subtle signs and impressions that may come from spirit. It follows five stages, from preparing the mind to writing down, interpreting and acting on what you receive.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Jeffrey Eisen on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His Insight Timer page offers free channelled messages and meditations from Shaltazar on oneness, self-love, purpose and inner guidance, plus regular live sessions. Anyone can listen at no cost.

free_resources.title: Shaltazar Messages
free_resources.description: A free online library of channelled Shaltazar messages, sorted by theme so you can browse by what you are going through. Each one is a short read.

free_resources.title: Living the Wisdom
free_resources.description: Jeffrey's free reflections on bringing the Shaltazar teachings into ordinary days, with pieces on balance, responsibility, feelings and trust.

flags: No visibly published email: jeffrey@jeffreyeisen.com appears only inside the PayPal donation form data on /support/, so it was not used; contact form at /connect/.
Prices for sessions, readings and the audio collection are not shown on his site (booked through Calendly or bought on Etsy), so all are 'Contact for pricing'.
The YouTube channel is named Shaltazar (@Shaltazar) but its owner name is 'Jeffrey Eisen - Coach, Channeler, Energy Intuitive'.
Insight Timer bio could only be partly quoted by WebFetch; bio check relied mainly on his own site pages.
